title: ci: add github pages deployment workflow
body:
This PR sets up automated deployment to GitHub Pages.

- Added `.github/workflows/pages.yml` to build and deploy the Vite app.
- Updated `vite.config.js` to set the base path to `/time-summarizer/` for correct asset loading on GitHub Pages.

**Note**: After merging this PR, you need to go to the repository settings on GitHub under **Settings > Pages** and ensure that the "Source" is set to **GitHub Actions**.

---
*🤖 Authored by Lango*
head: feat/github-pages
